class.name: AnimationWorkbenchEditorPlugin
class.brief_description: Built-in editor for skeletal animation assets and clip editing.
class.description: Provides the central skeleton and animation workspace, independent model preview, timeline, clip drafts and GLB asset import. The editor creates this plugin automatically for every project.

method.name: delete_range
method.description: Deletes the half-open interval in seconds from the current draft. Supports uncompressed 3D transform and blend shape tracks. Save separately to write the result to disk.

method.name: get_current_animation
method.description: Returns the current in-memory clip result.

method.name: open_player
method.description: Opens a central document for this player's actual libraries and previews a copy of its 3D animation root.

method.name: open_resource
method.description: Opens a SkeletonDefinition or Animation asset in a central document.

method.name: save_animation
method.description: Saves the current clip while retaining existing resource references.

method.name: select_animation
method.description: Selects an animation by its full player animation name.

method.name: undo_edit
method.description: Undoes one clip edit. Saving after undo writes that result to disk.
